# `PluginEvent::EntityRemoved`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-event">event</span> <span class="sdk-kind">event</span>

Source: **Events** (`crates/flux_plugin_sdk/src/events.rs`). Generated group: **Events**.

## When It Fires

Fired after one entity has been removed from the world.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`EntityInstanceId`](../structures/entityinstanceid.md) | `id` field stored as `EntityInstanceId` on `EntityEvent`. |
| `kind` | [`EntityKindId`](../structures/entitykindid.md) | `kind` field stored as `EntityKindId` on `EntityEvent`. |
| `cell` | UVec2 | `cell` field stored as `UVec2` on `EntityEvent`. |

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/events/pluginevent-entityremoved.md`](../../examples/events/pluginevent-entityremoved.md)_

```rust
impl MyPlugin {
    fn on_entity_removed(&mut self, event: &EntityEvent) -> Result<(), PluginError> {
        if self.selected_entity == Some(event.id) {
            self.selected_entity = None;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
```
